procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GER 35 agreed to have the RC representative as intrepreter.
facts: On Saturday 23rd, GER 35 failed to sign out. Later on, the RC penalized GER 35 with an SP for breaking SI 17.1.2 and at 21:04 the penalty was published on the ONB.
At 7:30 on Sunday 24th, GER 35 became aware that she had been penalized.
GER 35 lodged a scoring review, at 09:01. The answer was published at 9:30 and the request was declined.
Delta for the Europe class was displayed at 09:45, and GER 35 went sailing. After racing GER 35 signed in at 17:13. The protest time limit on Sunday 24th was at 17:45.
After arriving ashore, GER 35 went to eat something, prepared her boat for the night and reintroduced the discussion with the RC.
At 20:14, GER lodged a request for redress.
conclusions: GER 35 failed to deliver the request for redress as soon as reasonably possible after the relevant information was available, as required by RRS 61.2(b)(3).
Reintroducing the discussion after an official answer has been given is not a good reason for the International Jury to extend the time.
decision: The request for redress is invalid, the hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
